column1: # Candidate ingredients for the med100 expansion, in fixed order.
# Source list: ClinCalc DrugStats, The Top 300 of 2024, https://clincalc.com/DrugStats/Top300Drugs.aspx
# (data: MEPS 2014-2024, AHRQ), read 2026-11-21. Names taken from ranks 1 to 200, except glyburide and labetalol,
# which are not in ranks 1 to 200 and were added as spares (marked spare).
# Excluded: vitamins, biologics, insulins, combination products, inhalers, injectables.
# Rule: for each ingredient in order, DailyMed drug_name search, first up to 3 results, first one that
# passes parse_product is pinned. Stop at 100 products in total. Nothing is retried beyond that.
